specs.scene: Overhead flat-lay of an AI-video production desk, two hands entering from the bottom edge holding a stack of printed script pages face down. Surrounding objects packed to every edge and overlapping: a closed laptop, a ring light, a USB microphone, a pair of over-ear headphones, a small webcam, a coiled XLR cable, a stopwatch, a stack of blank language flashcards, a lavalier microphone clipped to a notepad, a USB flash drive, and a blank notepad with a pen resting diagonally across it. Small bare patches of desk surface show between the objects.
specs.source_quote: An AI avatar reads the script

recognisable.why: Individual objects like the laptop, mic and headphones are everyday items, but the assembled scene reads as generic AV-production gear rather than a household subject.

legibility.why: Dense overlapping objects still cohere into one textural mass typical of the flatlay layout, not separate ideas to resolve.

curiosity.why: Purely descriptive object arrangement, no stated or implied verdict.

subject.why: Hands entering give a partial human anchor but no single clear focal object or action.

credible.why: No figure is present, which scores full by rubric.

stakes.why: Implies reduced crew/equipment need but stakes are only weakly dramatized through props.

reexpress.why: The caption adds a new consequence (no crew) rather than repeating any title's wording.

specs.scene: Documentary photograph of a small corporate meeting room: a person's hands adjusting a ring light and microphone stand beside a closed laptop resting on a conference table, mid-adjustment, a chair pushed back as if someone just stepped away, a blank whiteboard visible in the background, natural window light crossing the table.
specs.source_quote: the value was never the generation, because the client can press generate themselves

recognisable.why: The office/meeting-room setup is generic corporate environment, not a household-name subject.

legibility.why: Single documentary scene with one focal mass, no comparison or multiple panels.

curiosity.why: The caption states a flat, unresolved verdict the viewer cannot confirm by looking, textbook top-quartile pattern.

subject.why: Hands mid-adjustment provide a human anchor though the person is not fully shown.

credible.why: No numeric figure is used, which scores full.

stakes.why: Implies a redefinition of where value lies, directly threatening those who assumed generation itself was billable.

reexpress.why: Restates the script's own internal insight in the image rather than repeating any title's claim, and none of the three titles use this phrasing.

specs.scene: A professional video camera mounted on a tripod, powered off with the lens cap on, standing alone in the corner of an empty studio space, blank white backdrop paper behind it, no other objects in frame.
specs.source_quote: One operator with an AI avatar can now do it in an afternoon

recognisable.why: A camera on a tripod is an instantly recognizable everyday object needing no explanation.

legibility.why: Single object, single focal mass, nothing else to resolve.

curiosity.why: The caption implies an unresolved verdict about why the camera is unused, though it leans descriptive rather than fully open-ended.

subject.why: One single distinctive object anchors the frame exactly as the rubric rewards.

credible.why: No figure is carried, which scores full.

stakes.why: Directly implies obsolescence of camera-based filming work, a real loss to anyone in that trade.

reexpress.why: Reinforces the 'no camera' mechanism visually without repeating the title's own wording.

specs.scene: A person seated at a small home studio desk, speaking into a studio microphone on a boom arm, wearing over-ear headphones, mid-sentence with mouth open, a ring light glowing beside them, a closed laptop resting on the desk, a blank plain wall to the left of the frame left clear for overlay text.
specs.source_quote: One operator with an AI avatar can now do it in an afternoon

recognisable.why: A person recording into a microphone is an everyday, instantly parsable action even without brand context.

legibility.why: One person, one action, one focal mass with a clean empty half for text.

curiosity.why: The caption describes a capability rather than posing an unresolved verdict the viewer must chase.

subject.why: Single human mid-action anchors the frame cleanly.

credible.why: No figure is carried, which scores full by rubric.

stakes.why: Implies the viewer could personally scale output this way, a moderate personal-gain stake.

reexpress.why: Restates the multi-language mechanism in softer terms without echoing any title's exact wording.
